title: A pool rewrite during launch preflight does not fail the run
description: Use an isolated gateway, node, pool, project, runs and private tmux server to dispatch a scripted dev run while a pool rewrite lands during its launch preflight's code probe. The engine records the retry, re-reads the inputs, launches the worker and reaches MONITOR. No operator runs, slots or tmux sessions are used.

launch-inputs-reload.intent: A configuration reload during preflight is retried once on the re-read inputs instead of failing the dispatch.
